products.name: dim_date
products.description: Calendar dimension, one row per day 2015-2030. Join facts on *_date_key (yyyymmdd integer). Mark `date` as the date column in Power BI.

column_comments.date_key: Surrogate key in yyyymmdd form, e.g. 20260903.
column_comments.year_month: Year and month label yyyy-MM for time-series charts.
column_comments.first_day_of_month: First calendar day of the month.
column_comments.last_day_of_month: Last calendar day of the month.

products.name: dim_customer
products.description: Customer dimension (SCD2). One row per customer version; customer_sk is unique per version, customer_id is the business key. Filter is_current = true for the latest version. Row customer_sk = -1 is the 'Unknown' member facts point to when a customer is missing from the CRM.
products.sql: SELECT xxhash64(CAST(customer_id AS STRING), CAST(effective_from AS STRING)) AS customer_sk, customer_id, customer_name, customer_type, first_name, last_name, state, city, postcode, street, number, unit, region, district, lon, lat, ship_to_address, loyalty_segment, loyalty_segment_name, units_purchased, is_active, source_valid_from_ts AS crm_valid_from, source_valid_to_ts AS crm_valid_to, effective_from, effective_to, is_current FROM ${catalog}.${silver}.customers UNION ALL SELECT -1, NULL, 'Unknown', 'unknown', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'Unknown', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, TIMESTAMP'1900-01-01', TIMESTAMP'9999-12-31', true

column_comments.customer_sk: Surrogate key, unique per customer version. Facts reference this. -1 = Unknown.
column_comments.customer_name: Name as 'LAST, FIRST' for individuals or the organisation name.
column_comments.region: Region as captured by the CRM (inconsistent coding).
column_comments.district: County / district as captured by the CRM (inconsistent coding).
column_comments.loyalty_segment_name: Loyalty segment label: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum.
column_comments.units_purchased: Lifetime units purchased per the CRM.
column_comments.is_active: TRUE when the CRM record is still open.
column_comments.crm_valid_from: Validity start of this record in the CRM (UTC).
column_comments.crm_valid_to: Validity end in the CRM (UTC); NULL while active.
column_comments.effective_from: Version valid from (UTC) in this platform.
column_comments.effective_to: Version valid until (UTC); 9999-12-31 for the current version.
column_comments.is_current: TRUE for the latest version of the customer.

products.name: dim_product
products.description: Product dimension built from every product seen in web orders and point-of-sale transactions (there is no product master upstream). Brand comes from the POS export when available, otherwise from the brand name found in the product name. Row product_sk = -1 is the 'Unknown' member.
products.sql: WITH order_products AS (SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name FROM ${catalog}.${silver}.sales_orders LATERAL VIEW explode(ordered_products) t AS p WHERE is_current = true), pos_products AS (SELECT product_id, product_name, brand FROM ${catalog}.${silver}.sales WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id <> ''), brands AS (SELECT DISTINCT brand FROM pos_products WHERE brand IS NOT NULL), all_products AS (SELECT product_id, max(product_name) AS product_name, count(*) AS times_sold FROM (SELECT product_id, product_name FROM order_products UNION ALL SELECT product_id, product_name FROM pos_products) GROUP BY product_id) SELECT xxhash64(ap.product_id) AS product_sk, ap.product_id, ap.product_name, coalesce(max(pp.brand), max(b.brand), nullif(regexp_extract(ap.product_name, '^([A-Za-z]{3,})', 1), ''), 'Unknown') AS brand, CASE WHEN max(pp.brand) IS NOT NULL THEN 'pos_export' WHEN max(b.brand) IS NOT NULL THEN 'name_match' WHEN regexp_extract(ap.product_name, '^([A-Za-z]{3,})', 1) <> '' THEN 'name_prefix' ELSE 'unknown' END AS brand_source, max(ap.times_sold) AS times_sold FROM all_products ap LEFT JOIN pos_products pp ON pp.product_id = ap.product_id LEFT JOIN brands b ON ap.product_name ILIKE concat('%', b.brand, '%') GROUP BY ap.product_id, ap.product_name UNION ALL SELECT -1, NULL, 'Unknown', 'Unknown', 'unknown', 0

column_comments.product_sk: Surrogate key. Facts reference this. -1 = Unknown.
column_comments.product_id: Catalogue product id shared by the web shop and POS.
column_comments.brand: Brand: from the POS export, else matched in the product name against known brands, else the leading word of the product name, else Unknown. See brand_source.
column_comments.brand_source: How brand was determined: pos_export, name_match, name_prefix or unknown.
column_comments.times_sold: Number of order lines / POS rows the product appeared in (helper for sorting).

products.name: fact_sales_order_line
products.description: Web-shop order lines. Grain: one row per order_number x line_number for the current version of each order. Amounts are in `currency` (USD). net_amount applies the line's promotion discount.
products.sql: WITH lines AS (SELECT o.order_number, o.customer_id, o.order_ts, o.order_date, pos + 1 AS line_number, p.id AS product_id, CAST(p.qty AS INT) AS quantity, CAST(p.price AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS unit_price, p.curr AS currency, p.promotion_info.promo_id AS promo_id, coalesce(p.promotion_info.promo_disc, 0) AS promo_discount_rate FROM ${catalog}.${silver}.sales_orders o LATERAL VIEW posexplode(o.ordered_products) t AS pos, p WHERE o.is_current = true) SELECT concat_ws('-', CAST(l.order_number AS STRING), CAST(l.line_number AS STRING)) AS order_line_id, l.order_number, l.line_number, coalesce(c.customer_sk, -1) AS customer_sk, coalesce(pr.product_sk, -1) AS product_sk, CAST(date_format(l.order_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT) AS order_date_key, l.order_ts, l.order_date, l.customer_id, l.product_id, l.quantity, l.unit_price, l.currency, CAST(l.quantity * l.unit_price AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS gross_amount, l.promo_id, l.promo_discount_rate, CAST(l.quantity * l.unit_price * l.promo_discount_rate AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS discount_amount, CAST(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.promo_discount_rate) AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS net_amount FROM lines l LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id AND c.is_current = true LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_product pr ON pr.product_id = l.product_id

column_comments.line_number: 1-based position of the line within the order.
column_comments.customer_sk: FK to dim_customer (current version at build time; -1 if unknown).
column_comments.order_date_key: FK to dim_date; NULL when the source order had no timestamp.
column_comments.customer_id: Customer business key (for lookups without the dimension).
column_comments.promo_id: Promotion id applied to the line, if any.
column_comments.promo_discount_rate: Discount rate applied to the line (0 when none).
column_comments.net_amount: gross_amount - discount_amount. Use this for revenue.

products.name: fact_sales_order
products.description: Web-shop order headers. Grain: one row per order_number (current version). Aggregates of fact_sales_order_line plus click-stream and promotion flags.
products.sql: SELECT o.order_number, coalesce(c.customer_sk, -1) AS customer_sk, CAST(date_format(o.order_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT) AS order_date_key, o.order_ts, o.order_date, o.customer_id, o.line_item_count, coalesce(l.units, 0) AS units, coalesce(l.gross_amount, 0) AS gross_amount, coalesce(l.discount_amount, 0) AS discount_amount, coalesce(l.net_amount, 0) AS net_amount, o.has_promotion, size(o.clicked_items) AS clicked_item_count, CAST(aggregate(o.clicked_items, 0L, (acc, x) -> acc + CAST(x[1] AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT) AS click_count, o.effective_from AS version_effective_from FROM ${catalog}.${silver}.sales_orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_number, sum(quantity) AS units, sum(gross_amount) AS gross_amount, sum(discount_amount) AS discount_amount, sum(net_amount) AS net_amount FROM ${catalog}.${gold}.fact_sales_order_line GROUP BY order_number) l ON l.order_number = o.order_number LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id AND c.is_current = true WHERE o.is_current = true

column_comments.order_date_key: FK to dim_date; NULL when the order had no timestamp.
column_comments.line_item_count: Number of lines in the order.
column_comments.net_amount: Sum of line net amounts. Use this for revenue.
column_comments.has_promotion: TRUE when a promotion was applied.
column_comments.version_effective_from: When the current version of the order was loaded (UTC).

products.name: fact_pos_sale
products.description: Point-of-sale transactions from the store export. Grain: one row per product sold (sale_id). Not linked to web-shop orders.
products.sql: SELECT s.sale_id, coalesce(c.customer_sk, -1) AS customer_sk, coalesce(pr.product_sk, -1) AS product_sk, CAST(date_format(s.order_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS INT) AS sale_date_key, s.order_date AS sale_date, s.customer_id, s.product_id, s.quantity, s.unit_price, s.currency, s.total_amount FROM ${catalog}.${silver}.sales s LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id AND c.is_current = true LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_product pr ON pr.product_id = s.product_id

column_comments.sale_id: Deterministic id of the POS row.
column_comments.total_amount: Sale amount (quantity x unit_price). Use this for POS revenue.

products.name: customers_current
products.description: Current version of every customer (excludes the Unknown member).
products.sql: SELECT * FROM ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_customer WHERE is_current = true AND customer_sk <> -1

products.name: sales_order_lines_obt
products.description: One-big-table view: web-shop order lines joined to customer, product and date. Best starting point for ad-hoc analysis, notebooks and Genie.
products.sql: SELECT f.order_line_id, f.order_number, f.line_number, f.order_ts, f.order_date, d.year, d.year_quarter, d.year_month, d.month_name, d.day_name, d.is_weekend, c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_type, c.state, c.city, c.loyalty_segment_name, c.is_active AS customer_is_active, p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand, f.quantity, f.unit_price, f.currency, f.gross_amount, f.promo_id, f.promo_discount_rate, f.discount_amount, f.net_amount FROM ${catalog}.${gold}.fact_sales_order_line f JOIN ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_customer c ON c.customer_sk = f.customer_sk JOIN ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_product p ON p.product_sk = f.product_sk LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.order_date_key

column_comments.net_amount: Revenue for the line after discount.

products.name: pos_sales_obt
products.description: One-big-table view: POS sales joined to customer, product and date.
products.sql: SELECT f.sale_id, f.sale_date, d.year, d.year_quarter, d.year_month, d.month_name, d.day_name, d.is_weekend, c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_type, c.state, c.city, c.loyalty_segment_name, p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand, f.quantity, f.unit_price, f.currency, f.total_amount FROM ${catalog}.${gold}.fact_pos_sale f JOIN ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_customer c ON c.customer_sk = f.customer_sk JOIN ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_product p ON p.product_sk = f.product_sk LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.sale_date_key

products.name: mv_web_sales
products.description: Governed web-shop sales metrics (revenue, orders, units, discount) by date, customer and product attributes. Use in dashboards and Genie instead of hand-written aggregations.
products.yaml:
version: 0.1
source: ${catalog}.${gold}.fact_sales_order_line
joins:
  - name: customer
    source: ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_customer
    on: source.customer_sk = customer.customer_sk
  - name: product
    source: ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_product
    on: source.product_sk = product.product_sk
  - name: calendar
    source: ${catalog}.${gold}.dim_date
    on: source.order_date_key = calendar.date_key
dimensions:
  - name: order_date
    expr: source.order_date
  - name: year_month
    expr: calendar.year_month
  - name: year_quarter
    expr: calendar.year_quarter
  - name: brand
    expr: product.brand
  - name: product_name
    expr: product.product_name
  - name: customer_state
    expr: customer.state
  - name: customer_type
    expr: customer.customer_type
  - name: loyalty_segment
    expr: customer.loyalty_segment_name
  - name: promo_id
    expr: source.promo_id
measures:
  - name: net_revenue
    expr: SUM(source.net_amount)
  - name: gross_revenue
    expr: SUM(source.gross_amount)
  - name: discount_amount
    expr: SUM(source.discount_amount)
  - name: units
    expr: SUM(source.quantity)
  - name: orders
    expr: COUNT(DISTINCT source.order_number)
  - name: order_lines
    expr: COUNT(1)
  - name: customers
    expr: COUNT(DISTINCT source.customer_id)
  - name: average_order_value
    expr: SUM(source.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT source.order_number)
  - name: discount_rate
    expr: SUM(source.discount_amount) / SUM(source.gross_amount)

products.yaml:

  - name: product
